result:
Backend phase-05 (US3, learning cards with milestones and notes) **passes** on attempt 1: all 10 API checks pass and all 194 unit tests pass.

**How it was run:** this session wasn't allowed to run `phase-05-verify.sh` without approval, which also happened in phases 01–04. So I ran the same checks as direct curl calls against `http://localhost:8080`, with the same inputs. Every response is saved in `loops/testing/runs/001-quickflow/backend-dev/phase-05/attempt-1/http/`, and `curl.log` lists every call's status code and the ids created.

| Check | Criterion | What was confirmed |
|---|---|---|
| C1 | AC-US3-1 | A new card is stored as `NOT_STARTED` with a creation time; description is optional |
| C2 | AC-US3-2, BR-8 | An empty, blank or missing title gets a 400 whose error names `title` |
| C3 | FR-05.1/05.2 | Title 201 characters is rejected, 200 accepted; description 2,001 rejected, 2,000 accepted |
| C4 | AC-US3-3 | Changing status to each of the three allowed values is saved; `DONE` or a missing status gets a 400 |
| C5 | AC-US3-4, BR-9 | A milestone is stored under its own card only, not done, with an optional target date |
| C6 | AC-US3-5 | Marking a milestone done and not done is saved, and the done/total counts follow; using another card's id gets a 404; removing it works |
| C7 | AC-US3-6 | A note is stored with its timestamp; blank or 5,001-character text is rejected, 5,000 accepted; using another card's id gets a 404; removing it works |
| C8 | AC-US3-7, BR-14 | Deleting a card means the card, its milestones and its notes are never returned again; every call on them gets a 404 |
| C9 | AC-US3-8 | Each card, alone and in the list, includes its milestones and notes; the list is newest first |
| C10 | swagger | All 10 operations and 9 schemas are present; the live docs, `backend/target/openapi.json` and the copy match |

**Coverage:** the runner again reported coverage as "skipped", for the same package-matching reason as phases 02–04. From `jacoco.csv`, domain line coverage is 399/409 = 97.6%, and 99.2% for the new learning package, so the 0.80 threshold is met anyway.

There were no open questions. AC-US3-9 is frontend-only and wasn't checked here.
